# Samaan Pantry

> Samaan Pantry is a recipe capture app for desi kitchens. Hit record while someone talks you through a dish, for up to ten minutes, and keep it as a recipe in the words they said. Andaza stays andaza.

Updated: 2026-11-21 (app version 1.7)

## Product

- Site: https://www.samanpantry.com/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6761982454 (listed as "Samaan Pantry: Family Recipes")
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later. There is no Android app, and no ship date.
- Company: Saman Technologies LLC, doing business as Samaan Technologies
- Contact: haaris@samaan.tech

## What it does

- Record a recipe: hit record while someone explains a dish, for up to 10 minutes, or choose a voice note or audio file. Recordings are turned into text on the company's server by ElevenLabs.
- Recordings and typed text can mix Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi, and English. The transcript is kept with the recipe.
- Links: paste a YouTube video, a recipe site, or an Instagram caption. Or type the recipe the way they say it.
- Andaza stays andaza. Approximate amounts are left as said instead of guessing a number nobody said.
- Family cookbooks: private to members. Invite by link or code. Starting one needs Samaan Pro. Joining is free.
- The Community book: any signed-in user can read it. A recipe made from a recording or pasted words is added to it when saved. Recipes from links are added only if the owner chooses.
- Pantry with barcode scan and Running low. Shopping lists that update the pantry. Pantry, lists, and recipes work without an account. Extraction, sync, and family cookbooks need one.

## Price

- Free: $0. New accounts get 5 recipe extractions for life. No card, no trial clock. Join family cookbooks. Read the Community book. Unlimited pantry and shopping lists.
- Samaan Pro: unlimited recipe extractions and starting family cookbooks. $7.99 a month or $59.99 a year, saving 37%. Purchases are handled by Apple. There is no lifetime plan.
